exp.desc:
- Till and cash-up
- Customer service at busy times

cl.p1: I spend most weekends on the fells, so when a friend needs boots or a waterproof, I am the one they ask. I would like to bring that enthusiasm to your shop floor.
cl.p2: I have two years of Saturday work in a café, where I ran the till, handled cash at closing and dealt with queues out of the door in summer. I am quick to learn product details and happy to tell a customer honestly when a cheaper option is the better choice.
cl.p3: I can work weekends and school holidays and up to 20 hours during term. A trial shift would suit me any Saturday.

cl.p1: You do not sell a washing machine on price; you sell it by asking how many people live in the house and what they wash. Seven years in electrical retail have taught me that, and it shows in my low return rate.
cl.p2: I advise on large and small appliances, arrange deliveries and installations and handle warranty claims with manufacturers. Last year I became responsible for ordering in my department and training two new colleagues.
cl.p3: My current store closes at the end of the year. I am flexible with shifts and would welcome an interview.
